name: Realistic Water Android - Mali GPU
description: Mali GPU support addon for the official Realistic Water Android bridge. On ARM Mali drivers (e.g. Mali-G52 Bifrost) that report Vulkan 1.2+ but lack compute subgroup ops or VK_KHR_push_descriptor, it serves hash-verified no-subgroup shader variants and a push-descriptor fallback - fixing 'Realistic Water failed' and unblocking water placement. Requires the official bridge (realistic-water-android).
